page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V, designed for high-throughput enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory density and rapid local disk access. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, reaching clock frequencies up to 4.2 GHz. The hardware architecture incorporates a 260 MB L3 cache alongside specialized instruction extensions, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). It is provisioned with 768.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a generous ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, while omitting discrete graphics hardware.

Data-intensive tasks benefit from 5,670 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, bypassing network overhead for low-latency operational data caching. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate exceptional throughput in uncached memory operations, achieving 506.7 GB/sec read and 207.77 GB/sec write bandwidth, placing the instance in the top tier of evaluated systems. Compute evaluations align with this profile: the instance recorded a PassMark CPU score of 93,126.45, a PassMark database operations metric of 35,335.9, and Redis SET throughput exceeding 122.52 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput reached 136.17 GB/sec, while CPU-based inference workloads delivered prompt processing rates of 261.63 tokens/sec on 7B parameter models.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the inclusion of direct-attached NVMe storage and vast RAM reserves minimizes bottlenecks for stateful processing without requiring remote storage calls. The lack of bundled public IPv4 addresses requires virtual network integration for outbound routing. Given the combination of high thread density, extreme memory bandwidth, and local storage, Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is specifically suited for in-memory databases, large-scale relational database management systems, big data analytics engines, and high-concurrency transactional caching platforms.

Equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs, 48 physical cores, and a 260 MB L3 cache, the server includes 768.0 GB of RAM alongside 5,670 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, with no discrete GPU. The system features AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix acceleration, achieving top-tier memory bandwidth of 506.7 GB/sec read and 207.77 GB/sec write. In benchmark testing, the instance delivered over 122.52 million Redis SET operations per second and high-throughput database operations. With high memory density per core and direct-attached NVMe capacity, this configuration is well matched for large in-memory databases, caching layers, and demanding enterprise database workloads.
